@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Chinese people traditionally eat d______gs on Chinese New Year's Eve because they symbolize wealth.
= dumplings
~詞義 dumpling（n.）水餃
~原文 Chinese people traditionally eat dumplings on Chinese New Year's Eve because they symbolize wealth.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: When Mary's grandfather fainted, she called an a______e to take him to the hospital.
= ambulance
~詞義 ambulance（n.）救護車
~原文 When Mary's grandfather fainted, she called an ambulance to take him to the hospital.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The Smiths have a huge house, so they have hired a h______r to help take care of it.
= housekeeper
~詞義 housekeeper（n.）管家
~原文 The Smiths have a huge house, so they have hired a housekeeper to help take care of it.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Henry became very f______d of gardening after discovering how relaxing it felt to watch his plants grow each week.
= fond
~詞義 fond（adj.）喜歡的
~原文 Henry became very fond of gardening after discovering how relaxing it felt to watch his plants grow each week.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: It is very important to remain t______l with your partner in a relationship.
= truthful
~詞義 truthful（adj.）誠實的
~原文 It is very important to remain truthful with your partner in a relationship.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: It is a ______ that Allen survived the horrible car accident and didn't suffer any major injuries.
A: miracle
B: lottery
C: follower
D: lobby
= A
~詞義 miracle（n.）奇蹟
~原文 It is a miracle that Allen survived the horrible car accident and didn't suffer any major injuries.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The farmer grows tomatoes and strawberries in a big ______.
A: peanut
B: missile
C: greenhouse
D: apron
= C
~詞義 greenhouse（n.）溫室
~原文 The farmer grows tomatoes and strawberries in a big greenhouse.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The boy is very short, so he has to stand on a ______ when he brushes his teeth.
A: mist
B: horn
C: stool
D: fence
= C
~詞義 stool（n.）凳子
~原文 The boy is very short, so he has to stand on a stool when he brushes his teeth.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: An elephant's ______ serves as both a nose and a hand, allowing it to grab objects easily.
A: storm
B: mist
C: horn
D: trunk
= D
~詞義 trunk（n.）象鼻
~原文 An elephant's trunk serves as both a nose and a hand, allowing it to grab objects easily.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Max started learning English last month, and he could write the whole English ______ within just a few days.
A: alphabet
B: grasshopper
C: lobby
D: missile
= A
~詞義 alphabet（n.）字母表
~原文 Max started learning English last month, and he could write the whole English alphabet within just a few days.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: peanut
B: missile
C: excelled
D: arrested
E: followers
F: fighters

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: The athlete ______ at long-distance running, breaking several school records before graduating.
= C
~詞義 excel（v.）擅長
~原文 The athlete excelled at long-distance running, breaking several school records before graduating.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The ______ flew a long distance and exploded when it hit the building.
= B
~詞義 missile（n.）飛彈
~原文 The missile flew a long distance and exploded when it hit the building.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Jane is a famous YouTuber. She has more than a million ______.
= E
~詞義 follower（n.）追隨者
~原文 Jane is a famous YouTuber. She has more than a million followers.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Many people find that ______ butter pairs perfectly with jam on toast.
= A
~詞義 peanut（n.）花生
~原文 Many people find that peanut butter pairs perfectly with jam on toast.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The police officers rushed into the room and ______ the man for possessing illegal weapons.
= D
~詞義 arrest（v.）逮捕
~原文 The police officers rushed into the room and arrested the man for possessing illegal weapons.

F: tub

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Danny always feels grateful to have a roof over his head during ______ weather.
= C
~詞義 stormy（adj.）暴風雨的
~原文 Danny always feels grateful to have a roof over his head during stormy weather.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: In the story, the ______ witch put an evil spell on the beautiful princess.
= A
~詞義 wicked（adj.）邪惡的
~原文 In the story, the wicked witch put an evil spell on the beautiful princess.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: After swimming 20 laps in the pool, Janice took a rest in the hot ______.
= F
~詞義 tub（n.）浴缸
~原文 After swimming 20 laps in the pool, Janice took a rest in the hot tub.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: The ______ of their teamwork showed in how smoothly the group completed every assignment throughout the semester.
= D
~詞義 excellence（n.）優異
~原文 The excellence of their teamwork showed in how smoothly the group completed every assignment throughout the semester.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: I don't have time for lunch. ______, I don't feel hungry at all.
= B
~詞義 anyhow（adv.）反正
~原文 I don't have time for lunch. Anyhow, I don't feel hungry at all.
